key.name: magnification
key.description: How large icons grow under the pointer; 1 turns magnification off.

key.name: auto-hide
key.summary: When the dock slides out of the way
key.description: never: always shown, windows stay above it. fullscreen: hidden while a window is fullscreen. smart: also hidden while a window reaches down under it.

key.name: monitor
key.description: Index of the monitor the dock sits on, or -1 for the primary monitor.

key.name: show-running
key.summary: Running apps that are not pinned

key.name: show-badges
key.description: Unread counts and progress bars that apps publish.

key.name: click-minimizes
key.summary: Clicking the active app minimizes it
